messages:
sam: Quick check — we need API/runtime/console/SDK bumps to land before the cutoff tomorrow 11:00 PT. Who's owning which repo?

maria: I'll take API + changelog. Will open changelog PR in a bit. :memo:

alina: I'll handle runtime and the quantization note. PR almost ready, just one failing test. cc @tj for perf note in the release notes.

tj: Ack - will add the perf blurb and the 'known issue' for <1% latency variance. Do we want a single cross-repo section or separate per-repo notes?

maria: Prefer single 'Platform' section with bullets for each component, easier for customers.

ken: I can pick up SDKs (JS + Python). I'll bump versions after runtime PR merges so clients use the right model tag.

sam: Thanks. Can we call out blockers? Anything preventing merges?

alina: Runtime test failure is flakiness on GPU CI. Investigating. If it doesn't land by 06:30 PT please hold the runtime bump and I'll coordinate a follow-up patch.

maria: Changelog PR: https://git.redwood.dev/api/changelog/pull/412 — still needs review from @ken for compatibility note.

ken: Reviewing now. For SDKs, sequence: bump runtime tag -> cut SDK minor -> publish. I can handle the publish step, just need the final runtime tag.

release-bot: Release cutoff reminder: scheduled cutoff at 2025-09-10 11:00:00 PT (unix 1755555900). Please ensure all PRs are merged or flagged with post-cutoff plan.

sam: OK timeline recap: merge API + changelog by 08:30 PT, runtime by 06:30 PT (or flag), SDK bumps after runtime tag, console notes + screenshots by 09:00 PT.

tj: Console will have a short banner screenshot, I'll attach by 08:45 PT.

alina: If runtime fails, I'll open a rollback-safe follow-up and ping infra to rerun flaky job.

maria: @ken once you publish SDKs, drop the npm/pypi versions here so I can update docs and release notes.

ken: Will do. Expected publish time ~10:15 PT if everything goes green.

sam: Thanks all — please ping this thread when your PRs are green so I can do a final sweep before cutoff. :thumbsup:
